name: Wireless Earbuds
description: Pocket-sized earbuds with 30-hour battery life, active noise cancelling and a case that survives being sat on. Twice.

name: 4K Monitor
description: 27 inches of IPS panel, 99% sRGB and a stand that actually goes high enough. Your dashboards deserve this many pixels.

name: Mechanical Keyboard
description: Hot-swappable tactile switches, PBT keycaps and a satisfying thock that your coworkers will definitely notice.

name: USB-C Hub
description: Seven ports, 100 W pass-through charging and 4K HDMI. Ends the dongle drawer era for good.

name: Running Shoes
description: Responsive foam, breathable knit upper and a rocker sole tuned for long, easy miles on road or treadmill.

name: Denim Jacket
description: Rigid selvedge denim that breaks in beautifully. Classic trucker cut with deep inside pockets for a phone and a paperback.

name: Cotton T-Shirt
description: Heavyweight organic cotton tee that keeps its shape after fifty washes. Comes in the only colour that matters: black.

name: Leather Wallet
description: Slim full-grain leather bifold with RFID blocking. Fits six cards, some cash, and zero receipts you will never read.

name: Coffee Grinder
description: Conical burr grinder with 40 settings, from espresso fine to cold-brew coarse. Quiet enough for 6 a.m. deploys.

name: Air Purifier
description: True HEPA filter for rooms up to 40 m², with an auto mode that reacts to air quality and a whisper-quiet night setting.

name: Desk Lamp
description: Flicker-free LED arm lamp with five colour temperatures and a USB port in the base for your phone.

name: Ceramic Plant Pot
description: Hand-glazed stoneware pot with drainage and a bamboo saucer. The plant is sold separately, unfortunately.

name: Yoga Mat
description: 6 mm natural-rubber mat with a grippy top layer and alignment lines, so your downward dog stays pointed down.

name: Dumbbell Set
description: Adjustable 2–24 kg dumbbells with a quick-dial selector. Replaces an entire rack in your spare corner.

name: Cycling Helmet
description: Lightweight in-mould shell with MIPS protection, 18 vents and a rear light that clips on magnetically.

name: Insulated Water Bottle
description: Double-walled steel keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Leak-proof lid, dishwasher-safe, dent-tolerant.

name: Data Engineering Book
description: From batch to streaming: pipelines, orchestration, lakehouses and the art of idempotent reloads. Dog-ear friendly.

name: Sci-Fi Novel
description: A generation ship, a mutinous AI and a mystery 400 years in the making. You will read it in one weekend.

name: Streaming Systems Handbook
description: Watermarks, windows and exactly-once semantics explained with diagrams you can actually follow.

name: Cooking for Engineers
description: Recipes written as flowcharts, with timing diagrams for the tricky bits. Deterministic results, every time.

name: Face Serum
description: Lightweight niacinamide and hyaluronic acid serum for glowy, hydrated skin. Fragrance-free and fuss-free.

name: Sunscreen SPF50
description: Broad-spectrum SPF50 that leaves no white cast and sits nicely under makeup. Reapply every two hours.

name: Clay Face Mask
description: Kaolin and green-tea clay mask that clears pores in ten minutes. Pairs well with a podcast.

name: Lip Balm Trio
description: Three shea-butter balms: unscented, mint and a sheer berry tint. One for every pocket.
